About this video

Created by Maths by Zosiama. Set 1, question 2: Construct a triangle of sides 4 cm, 5 cm and 6 cm and then a triangle similar to it whose sides are 2/3 of the corresponding sides of the first triangle. Answer: △A′BC′: BC′ = 4 cm, A′B ≈ 3.33 cm, A′C′ ≈ 2.67 cm.

Every frame is drawn in code on one canvas as a pure function of time (60 fps). No video models, stock footage, photos or AI images. Narration: Kokoro-82M voice (Apache-2.0), generated offline. Music and sound effects: synthesised in code. Fonts: Fredoka (SIL OFL 1.1) and a DejaVu Sans subset for maths symbols (Bitstream Vera licence). MP4/WebM muxing: Mediabunny (MPL-2.0, source: github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny).
